news.title: Chelsea held 2-2 by Hull City
news.summary: Chelsea were held to a 2-2 draw by Hull City. Goal Zone's original match summary focuses on the key moments and what the result means for both teams.
news.body:
Chelsea were held to a 2-2 draw by Hull City in an entertaining Premier League match.

The visitors showed character to stay in the contest and leave with a point, while Chelsea will look at the chances and defensive moments that prevented them from taking all three points.

news.title: Liverpool held by Fulham in goalless draw
news.summary: Liverpool were unable to find a winner against Fulham as the sides shared the points in a 0-0 draw.
news.body:
Liverpool were held to a goalless draw by Fulham. The result leaves both sides with a point from a match in which neither team managed to break the deadlock.

For Goal Zone readers, the main takeaway is a result that highlights the importance of turning possession and chances into goals.

news.title: Arsenal beat Sunderland 2-0
news.summary: Arsenal earned a 2-0 victory over Sunderland, strengthening their early league position with another clean sheet.
news.body:
Arsenal secured a 2-0 win over Sunderland. The result gives Arsenal another positive result and continues a strong defensive start.

The match also gives Arsenal supporters plenty to discuss as the team builds momentum in the league.

news.title: Manchester derby ends goalless
news.summary: Manchester United and Manchester City shared the points after a 0-0 draw in the Manchester derby.
news.body:
Manchester United and Manchester City played out a goalless Manchester derby. Neither side was able to find the decisive finish, so the two teams left with one point each.
